tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: Get full content of test writing rules. Two modes: (1) by ID — pass ids with comma-separated rule IDs; (2) by filter — pass metadata filters to retrieve all matching rules. Returns the complete markdown body including detection patterns, examples, and fix guidance for each rule.

ids.description: Comma-separated rule IDs. Examples: 'DESIGN-001,CONV-003'. When provided, filter parameters are ignored.

group.description: Filter by rule group. Only used when ids is not provided.

test_type.description: Filter by test type: a rule is returned when its test-types field declares this type (or declares 'all'). Without group, returns the composed catalog for the type — its own rule group plus every convention, design, isolation, and provider rule declaring it — identical to the matching build_rule_package call. With group, filters within that group. Only used when ids is not provided.

test_category.description: Only rules applicable to this test category. Only used when ids is not provided.

scope.description: Only rules with this scope tag. Only used when ids is not provided.

enforce.description: Only rules at this enforcement level. Only used when ids is not provided.

scoped_review.description: When true, excludes rules marked scoped-review=exclude (whole-class concerns skipped in method-scoped reviews). When false or omitted, returns all rules. Only used when ids is not provided.

review_unit.description: Filter by the minimal evaluation input a rule's detection algorithm needs: 'method' (one test method body + its data provider), 'class-structure' (class shape only — no bodies), 'class-bodies' (multiple full method bodies together). Only used when ids is not provided.

tools.name: build_rule_package
tools.description: Render a rule catalog to a file in plugin storage and return its absolute path. Used at composition time so review agents are handed the catalog inline instead of fetching rules per-agent. Pass test_type to render that type's composed catalog — its own rule group plus every convention, design, isolation, and provider rule whose test-types declares the type — byte-identical to get_rules(test_type=X). With no arguments it renders the composed unit catalog to unit-review.md. Pass group to render that single rule group instead (the placement reasoning prompts are reached this way; composition never includes them). Pass the optional scope filters (review_unit, test_category, scoped_review, scope, enforce) to render a SUBSET for a single review track. Packages are written under scope-derived filenames so the per-catalog packages built for one review coexist as distinct paths; the unscoped unit catalog keeps the canonical unit-review.md name.

group.description: Render this single rule group instead of composing a per-type catalog (e.g. group=placement, test_type=integration for the integration-to-unit migrating skill). Mirrors the get_rules group filter. Omit to compose the catalog for test_type.

test_type.description: The test type whose catalog to compose: rules are included when their test-types field declares this type (or declares 'all'). Mirrors the get_rules test_type filter. When group is set, filters within that group instead. Omit to compose the unit catalog.

review_unit.description: One value or a comma-separated list of: method, class-structure, class-bodies (no spaces around the commas). Renders only rules whose review-unit is in the set (e.g. 'class-structure,class-bodies' for a whole-class fused track). Filters by the minimal evaluation input a rule's detection algorithm needs. Omit to include every review-unit.

test_category.description: Only rules applicable to this test category. Omit to include every category.

scope.description: Only rules with this scope tag. Mirrors the get_rules scope filter. Omit to include every scope.

enforce.description: Only rules at this enforcement level. Mirrors the get_rules enforce filter. Omit to include every enforcement level.

scoped_review.description: When true, excludes rules marked scoped-review=exclude (whole-class concerns skipped in method-scoped reviews). When false or omitted, includes all rules.
